## Work unit and scope

- Stable work unit: TLM-___ (the ID is **not** the GitHub PR number)
- Prerequisites and accepted merge SHAs:
- Implemented functional behavior and any excluded scope:

## Evidence and acceptance

- [ ] Unit acceptance criteria implemented, not merely documented
- [ ] Node unit/property tests exercised against current PR head
- [ ] Build, frozen install and TypeScript checks pass
- [ ] Browser and accessibility paths tested where applicable
- [ ] User privacy, source provenance and model result correctness checked
- [ ] Performance and resource limits verified where applicable
- [ ] Deployment or rollback notes supplied if operational behavior changes
- [ ] Canonical registry updated with actual PR number, status and evidence

## Security and independent operation

No private keys in source or test fixtures. Core public learning must not depend on an external software product, mandatory login, remote AI or payments. Serious discovered vulnerabilities must be fixed before an affected release. Human auditor signoff is not an engineering prerequisite.
